title: Tell a friend about a conversation
instructions: Read the conversation in the library. The next day, Mila tells her friend Aisha about it. Complete Mila's report.
context: Mila: Hi! I'm looking for a book about American history.
Mrs Patel: We have lots of history books. I'll show you where they are.
Mila: Great, thanks. I need it for a project.
Mrs Patel: You can borrow three books at a time.
Mila: Oh, I didn't know that.
Mrs Patel: But you must bring them back in two weeks.

items.text: “Yesterday I went to the library. I told Mrs Patel that I {{was looking}} for a book about American history.
She said that they {{had}} lots of history books and that she {{would show}} me where they {{were}}.
items.hint: have → had, will show → would show, are → were

Then she said that I {{could}} borrow three books at a time.
I said that I {{hadn't known|didn't know}} that.
